scenarios.fact: Exact rooms, sources, embeddings fixture, and personas exist in the fresh target or arm-isolated namespace.
Authorized source-file upload, metadata, download, and deletion preserve ownership and authority.
scenarios.planBullet: authorized source-file upload, metadata, download, and deletion

scenarios.fact: The outsider cannot retrieve sources, search results, questions, answers, or progress.
scenarios.planBullet: keyword and vector retrieval with outsider denial

scenarios.fact: Keyword retrieval returns the frozen expected source set.
scenarios.planBullet: keyword and vector retrieval with outsider denial

scenarios.fact: Vector retrieval uses the ordinary supported path or records an explicit GAP.
scenarios.planBullet: keyword and vector retrieval with outsider denial

scenarios.fact: A question streams multiple durable authoritative progress updates before terminal completion.
scenarios.planBullet: streamed durable progress before terminal completion

scenarios.fact: The answer retains valid citations to authorized source records.
Confirmed cancellation fences every late durable patch.
scenarios.planBullet: cancellation fencing against late durable patches

scenarios.fact: Retry is idempotent and duplicates neither questions nor answers.
scenarios.planBullet: idempotent retry without duplicate questions or answers

scenarios.fact: Complete, failed, cancelled, timed-out, and ambiguous outcomes remain distinct.
scenarios.planBullet: distinct complete, failed, cancelled, timed-out, and ambiguous outcomes

scenarios.fact: A second member observes the progress live through the attributed path.
scenarios.planBullet: a second member observing progress live

scenarios.fact: A scheduled external refresh runs with server-side secret custody; secrets stay out of clients, logs, and receipts.
scenarios.planBullet: scheduled external refresh with server-side secret custody

scenarios.fact: Only exact fresh targets or arm-owned records, files, schedules, and secrets are retired; unrelated baseline state is preserved.
